description_en: Describes the route entries of an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）路由条目
name: DescribeExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECR instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en: The region where the ECR instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 专线网关实例所属地域
parameters.name: query_region_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the route that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的路由条目的目标网段
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block

parameters.help_en: The ID of the next hop instance
parameters.name: nexthop_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The AS path of the route
parameters.name: as_path

parameters.help_en: The community value of the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) route
parameters.name: community

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no subsequent queries are required.
If a subsequent query is required, set the value to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1～2147483647。默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run but does not modify the service resource.
false (default): sends the request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

Code.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of 200 indicates that the call is successful. Other values indicate that the call failed. For more information, see the Error Codes section
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message. This message is used to replace the `%s` variable in the value of the ErrMessage parameter.

For example, if the value of ErrMessage is The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and the value of DynamicMessage is DtsJobId, the specified DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1～2147483647。默认值：10

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

If this parameter is empty, no subsequent query is sent.
If a value is returned, the value is the token that is used for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

AsPath.description_en: The AS path of the route

Community.description_en: The community value of the BGP route

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route

Med.description_en:
The MED value of the BGP route. The MED value is used to select the optimal route between an ECR and a transit router.

You can set the MED value to 2,000 and the path between the TR and the ECR becomes the default path.
If the path is not the default path, this parameter is empty.
For transit routers in the same CEN, you can set the MED value of only one associated object to 2000
Med.description_zh:
BGP路由条目携带的MED值，作用于专线网关与TR之间。 
MED可配置为2000（配置后则此TR与ECR作为Default路径） 
非Default路径时，此MED值为空 
同一个CEN的TR只能有一个关联对象的MED为可配置为2000

NexthopInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the next hop instance

NexthopInstanceRegionId.description_en: The region where the next hop instance is deployed
NexthopInstanceRegionId.description_zh: 下一跳实例所属的地域

Status.description_en: The status of the ECR instance

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

True: The call is successful.
False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败
